scorer_definitions.corpus_rule: one page per URL in any pair of this run (same-site or cross-site), the usable fetch nearest the last listed day
scorer_definitions.page_rule: usable fetch (>= 50 main-text words) nearest the pair's day, not after the last listed day; pair's day is the day (per-day) or the latest listed day the pair was strictly ordered (pooled)

prediction_check.prediction: BM25F and the text vote each order held-out same-site top-10 pairs between 0.55 and 0.65 and above their cross-site rate
prediction_check.label: PREDICTED before the held-out days were opened. Observed values are scorer outputs (PREDICTED) on REAL orders.
prediction_check.mode: design dry run, not a test
prediction_check.population: pooled records (one per search and URL pair across the listed days), searches o30 and a70, consensus top 10, pairs with usable HTML for both pages, duplicate content dropped
prediction_check.rule: Point estimates, ties count half. 'between' means 0.55 <= same-site rate <= 0.65. 'above' means same-site rate > cross-site rate of the same scorer on the same lists. difference_interval_above_zero is reported and is not part of the prediction.
